answer.summary: E2E job failed because the OpenAEV backend never became ready: /api/me never returned 200 in 300s (last HTTP 000). The container log ends with a Spring Boot ERROR right after the Add_tenant_id_to_execution_traces migration, but the logged exception is cut off, so the root cause isn't visible. The PR adds a new migration (V6_20261120160000000) and changes persistence code, so a deterministic startup failure is plausible. Not confirmed; check the full stack trace from the container log.
